### Added

- (agent-platform) [Start every session through start_session](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2918) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — For operators: the portal now starts every session through agent-manager's `start_session` tool as the signed-in person, the one place where an agent and a workspace's access check meet. Needs agent-manager 1.13.0 or later on every installation the portal serves.
- (agent-platform) [Explain an empty or incomplete agents list on Customize](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2948) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — Customize › Agents explains an empty list again: `No agents yet` with a `Create your first agent` link, `kagent is not installed on <environment>` with `Go to Installations`, a note for an environment that could not be asked, and a thin bar while more agents load.
- (agent-platform) [Scope the Model hosting pages to one environment](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2951) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — Model hosting (Running models, GPU pools, Model cache) has the Environment select in its header, shared with Customize › Models, so you can see and change which environment it shows. The `Could not read … environment` warnings now read as one sentence for one environment and for several.
- (agent-platform) [Add a Show tool activity switch to the session page](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2953) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — The session page has a `Show tool activity` switch after the start time. Turned off, it shows only the conversation: messages, questions and the approval the session waits on. The portal remembers the choice per person.
- (agent-platform) [Say where the Usage data starts when the range reaches back further](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2956) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — When the selected time range on Usage reaches back before an environment's records, Overview, Cost and Connectors say since when calls were recorded, such as `The gateway has recorded model calls only since 9 Sep 2026, so its figures cover 36 of the 90 days.` Cost no longer compares spend against a partly covered period.
- (agent-platform) [Move the skill page's facts into its Overview and share the connector page's Used by list](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2968) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — The skill page is a single column: source, path, branch and `Latest commit` sit in a `Where it lives` section of the Overview tab. `Latest commit` opens the skill's folder at that commit on GitHub, replacing the `View source` button. Used by lists agents as a connector's Used by does.
- (agent-platform) [Workspaces tab lists an Organization's workspaces](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2961) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — Customize has a Workspaces tab, where an installation lists the workspace-manager in muster. It lists your Organization's workspaces with their sources, repositories, storage, last sync and sessions, and offers `Sync now` and `Delete…`. Creating and editing workspaces come later.
- (agent-platform) [Explain a missing kagent on Home the way Customize › Agents does](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2964) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — When there is no agent to start a session with, Home says why as Customize › Agents does: kagent is not installed (with `Go to Installations`), the environment that runs it is switched off in Cluster access, or `No environment this portal can reach runs kagent.` It no longer reads as if nobody had created an agent.
- (app) [Show the full Giant Swarm logo on the Agent Platform sign-in page](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2954) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — The Agent Platform sign-in page shows the full Giant Swarm logo in its brand colours, instead of the ant beside the words "Agent Platform". A deployment with its own logo shows that one.
- (muster) [Open a connector's Tools tab on the Connectors search](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2949) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — A connector opened from a tool-name search on Customize › Connectors shows its Tools tab filtered to that search. A search that finds nothing says which tools it could not search, such as `The tools of <connector> were not searched: they need your sign-in.`
- (muster) [Offer Edit in Git for GitOps-managed workflows](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2950) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — A workflow managed through Flux has `Edit in Git…` in its page's ⋮ menu, as connectors do. It names the HelmRelease or Kustomization that manages the workflow, links to its source and explains how to change it through a pull request.
- (muster) [Details tab with technical details on the connector page](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2952) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — A connector's page has a Details tab with its `Sign-in`, health, `Calls this month` and `Added` date, replacing the facts column. A `Technical details` section holds its configuration, authentication, health detail and GitOps source, and opens by itself while the connector has failed.
- (muster) [Split the workflow page into Overview, Usage and Details tabs](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2960) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — A workflow's page is organized in Overview, Usage and Details tabs in a single column. `View manifest` in the ⋮ menu shows the full Workflow resource as YAML, with `Copy manifest`.
- (muster) [Give every connector tool a page of its own and list the tools as links](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2966) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — Each tool of a connector opens on its own page, with its description, input schema, a form to `Run` it and the full result. The connector's Tools tab lists the tools as links marked `Reads` or `Changes things`, and going back keeps its search and filter.

### Fixed

- (agent-platform) [Show the Usage token breakdown, align the time range](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2946) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — Usage › Overview always shows the `Tokens per day, by type` chart instead of folding it away, the rate-limit figure reads `Rate limited`, and the time range lines up with the Environment select in the Usage header.
- (agent-platform) [Answer a still-running resumed turn 202 on the streaming answer route instead of a 500](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2947) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — Answering an agent's question or approval in a session no longer shows an error when the agent takes a while to continue. The page shows the agent still working, and the reply appears when it is done.
- (agent-platform) [Give select options in the agent shell more room](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2965) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — Dropdowns in the Agent Platform, such as the agent picker when starting a session, give each option more height and space between groups such as Favorites, so names, descriptions and groups are easier to tell apart. On touch screens every option is at least 44px tall.
- (agent-platform) [Retry a session delete while its last turn settles](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2970) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — Deleting a session right after the agent answered no longer fails. The portal retries for up to about 16 seconds, and the dialog says `Waiting for the session's last turn to settle; the delete goes through as soon as kagent allows it.`
- (agent-platform) [Withhold agent-manager actions where muster has no per-user sign-in](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2972) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — On an installation whose muster entry has no `authProvider`, the Agent Platform no longer offers creating, editing, updating skills of or deleting agents, or starting a session with them, which failed with an error. Each place says why instead.
- (muster-backend) [Refuse agent-manager calls under muster's shared identity](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2963) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow) — For operators: on a muster entry configured without an `authProvider`, the portal now refuses every tool call except muster's own `core_*` tools with a 403 that names the missing `authProvider`, instead of running agent-manager and other writes under muster's shared identity. AI chat leaves such a muster out of its tools.
- (ui-react) [Keep shell page header actions beside the title and aligned with the Environment select](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2967) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — Agent Platform page headers keep their buttons at the top right next to the title, even on a session with a long name, and line them up with the Environment select beside them, as on Model hosting and Usage.

### Development and CI/CD

- (deps) [Update dependency fast-xml-parser to v5.11.2](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2945) by [@renovate[bot]](https://github.com/renovate[bot])
- (deps) [Update dependency pg to v8.23.1](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/2977) by [@renovate[bot]](https://github.com/renovate[bot])
